claude-usage.title: Usage tracking
claude-usage.description: Connect a Claude account to fetch usage limits.
claude-usage.needsConnectedAccount: Connect this Claude account before tracking its usage.
claude-usage.browserUnavailable: Opening the sign-in page needs the DeliDev desktop app.
claude-usage.loading: Checking whether this server supports usage tracking.
claude-usage.unavailable: Usage tracking support could not be verified. Refresh and try again.
claude-usage.unreadable: The usage tracking state is not recognized. Update DeliDev and the server, then refresh.
claude-usage.updateRequired: Usage tracking needs a server update. Update the server, then connect a usage account.
claude-usage.preparing: Preparing the sign-in on the server.
claude-usage.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in with Claude.
claude-usage.waitingBody: Finish signing in in your browser. This sign-in only fetches usage and does not change your execution sign-in. Closing this dialog keeps the sign-in running.
claude-usage.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Open the original sign-in page again.
claude-usage.codePlaceholder: Paste the code shown in your browser
claude-usage.codeHelp: Paste the code only if your browser shows one. It is sent once and never displayed.
claude-usage.codeSubmitted: The approval code was submitted. Waiting for the server to finish the sign-in.
claude-usage.codeInvalid: The code was not sent. Check that you pasted only the code shown in your browser.
claude-usage.confirmBody: Usage will be shown for this signed-in account. Confirm it is the account you want to track. This does not prove it is the same account as your execution sign-in.
claude-usage.reviewLoading: Loading the signed-in account for review.
claude-usage.reviewChanged: The signed-in account changed after it was reviewed. Go back and sign in again.
claude-usage.backHelp: Going back discards this sign-in. Nothing is linked.
claude-usage.disconnectBody: Usage tracking stops and the usage sign-in is removed from this server. Your execution sign-in is not changed.
claude-usage.noObservation: No usage has been observed yet. Use Refresh to fetch the first observation.
claude-usage.staleNote: This observation is more than 5 minutes old. Use Refresh to fetch the latest usage.
claude-usage.backoff: The provider asked DeliDev to wait. Usage reads resume <s0/>.
claude-usage.rotationUncertain: The usage sign-in renewal result is unconfirmed. Reconnect the usage account to continue.
claude-usage.reconnectRequired: The usage sign-in needs to be connected again. The last observation is kept and marked out of date.
claude-usage.failure.rateLimited: The latest refresh was rate limited. The last accepted usage is kept.
claude-usage.failure.forbidden: The latest refresh was refused. The last accepted usage is kept.
claude-usage.failure.unauthorized: The usage sign-in was rejected. Reconnect the usage account.
claude-usage.failure.unavailable: The usage service was unavailable. The last accepted usage is kept.
claude-usage.failure.malformed: The usage response was not recognized. The last accepted usage is kept.
claude-usage.failure.empty: The usage response had no usable limits. The last accepted usage is kept.
claude-usage.failure.identityChanged: The usage sign-in belongs to a different account. Reconnect and review it again.
claude-usage.failure.unsupported: This usage sign-in is no longer supported. Reconnect the usage account.
claude-usage.login.canceled: The usage sign-in was canceled. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.login.expired: The usage sign-in expired. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.login.unsupported: Claude Code on this server cannot complete the usage sign-in. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.login.recovery: The usage sign-in needs recovery on the server. Cancel it to discard unconfirmed credentials.
claude-usage.login.failed: The usage sign-in failed. Nothing was linked.
claude-usage.statusUnconfirmed: The sign-in status could not be verified. No new sign-in will start.
claude-usage.requestFailed: The usage request could not be confirmed. Retry only the original request.
claude-usage.urlInvalid: The sign-in page address was not recognized, so it was not opened. Cancel and start the sign-in again.
